name: Anser Hard Serpulo
author: SarakaUnciv
description:
V.2.7 fix bug that ProductionMult not active Automatically
	
	-1. This mod [[]#00ff00]merge[[]] enemy unit into next tier unit [[]#ffff00]To prevent lag of 2000+ unit[[]] and can be [[]#00ffff]turn off[[]]
	
	0. This mod have setting that [[]#ff0000]disable[[]] all vanilla unit collision hitbox to prevent big unit from get stuck can be [[]#00ffff]turn on[[]] [[]#ff8000]require restart[[]]
	[[]#80ff80]This setting only effect unit to unit collision The bullet to unit is still the same[[]]
	
	1. This mod let you [[]#ffff00]customize[[]] [[]#ffff00]Casual[[]] Difficulty in [[]#00ffff]game setting[[]] also make other Difficulty [[]#ff0000]harder[[]]
	
	2.1 [[]#00ffff]configurable[[]] enemy [[]#ffff00]production[[]] speed up to [[]#ff0000]6400%[[]]
	Enemy production in most map [[]#ffff00]will begin after a while[[]] which [[]#ff0000]does not effect by this setting[[]]
	[[]#ff0000]Turn This setting on will override corresponding rules in custom game[[]]
	
	2.2 [[]#00ffff]configurable[[]] enemy [[]#ffff00]attack[[]] damage up to [[]#ff0000]6400%[[]]
	[[]#ff0000]Turn this setting on will override corresponding rules in custom game[[]]
	
	3. Make all serpulo sector [[]#ff0000]enemy base[[]] and can be [[]#00ffff]turn off[[]] and [[]#ff8000]require restart[[]]
	Make all Serpulo numbered sector [[]#ff0000]enemy base[[]]
	Vanilla enemy base sector now have [[]#ff8000]Extreme[[]] threat while other sector now have [[]#ff0000]Eradication[[]] threat
	[[]#a0ffa0]Vanilla enemy base sector map does not effect by threat level meaning they still have the same building and wave as in vanilla[[]]
	Numbered sector that does not have enemy base in vanilla this mod will make them generate base
	
	4. Mark all serpulo vanilla [[]#ff0000]enemy base[[]] sector with icon
	[[]#ff0000]Eradication[[]] threat is marked with melting other threat is marked with shocked
	[[]#ff0080]WARNING this mod will overwrite icon on all serpulo vanilla enemy base sector and can't be turn off[[]]
